title: Initialize trainable weights reproducibly
description: A quick reference for the scale, symmetry, and reproducibility terms used here.

terms.definition: Choosing trainable values before optimization begins updating the model.
Equal units receiving equal gradients and remaining indistinguishable after updates.
The number of input features accumulated into each output feature.
The number of output features that receive each input feature.
A zero-centered sampling rule balancing forward and backward width effects.
The intended variance of a sampling distribution, not one matrix's measurement.
The maximum absolute endpoint of a zero-centered uniform sampling interval.
The initial deterministic generator state controlling a reproducible sample stream.
Producing identical parameter values from identical requests and construction order.
A deterministic algorithm producing random-like values from an explicit state.
